safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(الر) disconnected letters, with no grammatical position. (تلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the overt sukūn on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; and (اللام) indicates distance, and (الكاف) indicates address. (آيات) khabar, nominative. (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (قرآن) conjoined to الكتاب by the wāw, genitive. (مبين) naʿt of القرآن, genitive.
The nominal sentence has no grammatical position; it is an initial sentence (ibtidāʾiyya).

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(ربما) kāffa and makfūfa. (يودّ) an imperfect verb, nominative. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil. (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil. (لو) a maṣdar particle. (كانوا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and (الواو) is in the position of a nominative, the ism (subject) of kāna. (مسلمين) khabar of كانوا, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (لو كانوا مسلمين) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi, the governing word being يودّ.
The clause «يودّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «كانوا مسلمين» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (لو).

* Rhetoric:
1- Expression by the opposite: in His saying, the Exalted, رُبَما يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ, the scholars of rhetoric differed over what is meant by this expression. The grammarians have established that ربما enters only upon the past tense? And what is meant by the sense of "fewness" that رب conveys? The first question was answered by saying that what is anticipated in the reports of Allah the Exalted is in the position of the past whose realisation is certain, as if it had been said: "often they wished". The second was answered by saying that this is a way that occurs in the usage of the Arabs, as in their saying "perhaps you will regret your deed", and "often a person regrets what he does", where they have no doubt about his regret and do not intend to make it few. Sensible people guard against exposing themselves to the merely conjectured just as they guard against the established certainty. This answer is beautiful, but more beautiful than it is to say: the Arabs express a meaning by what conveys the opposite of what they intend.

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(ذرهم) an imperative verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, obligatorily so, its implied form being "أنت" (you). (يأكلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis of a request, its jussive marking being the dropping of the nūn; and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الواو) conjunction. (يتمتّعوا) like يأكلوا, and conjoined to it. (الواو) conjunction. (يلههم) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to يأكلوا, its jussive marking being the dropping of the weak letter; and (هم) is like the first. (الأمل) fāʿil, nominative. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (سوف) a particle of futurity. (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the retention of the nūn; and (الواو) is the fāʿil, while the object of يعلمون is omitted, its implied form being "the outcome of their affair".
The clause «ذرهم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يأكلوا ....» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined by the fāʾ.
That is: "if you leave them, they will eat ..".
The clause «يتمتّعوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يأكلوا.
The clause «يلههم الأمل ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يأكلوا.
The clause «سوف يعلمون» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if the affair of this world occupies them, then they will know".

* Morphology:
(الأمل): a samāʿī maṣdar (a verbal noun taken by hearing) of the verb أمل; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative. (أهلكنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (من) a redundant preposition, for the inclusion of the whole genus. (قرية) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. (إلّا) for restriction. (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl. (اللام) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (كتاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (معلوم) naʿt of كتاب, nominative.
The clause «أهلكنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لها كتاب ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from قرية because of the presence of the wāw.

* Morphology:
(معلوم): a passive participle of the triliteral علم; its wazn is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) a particle of negation. (تسبق) an imperfect verb, nominative. (من) a redundant preposition, for the inclusion of the whole genus. (أمّة) genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of تسبق. (أجلها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (ها) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) like the first. (يستأخرون) an imperfect verb, nominative; and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «ما تسبق ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما يستأخرون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause ما تسبق.

safi-cedvel:6-7.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (يا) a vocative particle. (أيّ) the one addressed, a specific indefinite, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; and (ها) is a particle of alerting. (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, ʿaṭf bayān of أيّ, or a badal. (نزّل) a passive past verb. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نزّل). (الذكر) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (إنّك) a particle resembling the verb, a naskh (abrogating) particle, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (مجنون) khabar of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «the vocative and its answer» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نزّل عليه الذكر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «إنّك لمجنون» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the vocative.
(لوما) a particle of offering. (تأتينا) an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, while the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you). (بالملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأتينا). (إن) a particle of jussive condition. (كنت) a defective past verb, a naskh verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a jussive, the protasis. And (التاء) is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, the ism of كان. (من الصادقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of كنت, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «تأتينا ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «كنت من الصادقين» has no grammatical position; resumptive. And the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, that is: "if you are one of the truthful in what you claim, then bring us the angels".

* Morphology:
(مجنون): a passive participle of the triliteral جنّ; its wazn is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:10-11.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (أرسلنا) like نزّلنا [Note: in the preceding verse (9).]. (من قبلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا), and (الكاف) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (في شيع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of the implied object, that is: "We sent messengers among the sects". (الأوّلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ [Note: and it is originally an adjective of an omitted described noun, that is: "the sects of the earlier nations".].
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied oath.
(الواو) conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (يأتيهم) an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من) a redundant preposition. (رسول) genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of يأتي. (إلّا) for restriction. (كانوا) a defective past verb, and (الواو) is the ism of كان. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يستهزئون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative; and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «ما يأتيهم من رسول ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أرسلنا [Note: or to the implied oath clause.].
The clause «كانوا.. يستهزئون» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the object of يأتيهم.
The clause «يستهزئون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا. [Note: Or from رسول; but it is not valid as an adjective of رسول.]

* Morphology:
(شيع): plural of شيعة, a noun for a group agreed upon a path. In al-Miṣbāḥ: every people who gathered upon a matter are a shiʿa. It then became a name for a particular group. The wazn of شيعة is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn, and the wazn of شيع is فعل, with kasra then fatḥa.

* Rhetoric:
Scrambled laff and nashr in His saying, the Exalted: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ. Then He followed that with His saying وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ to the end of the verse, meaning that this is their habit, and the habit of the Jāhiliyya with all the prophets; so do not grieve, but follow those before you and take them as your example.
It is applied to:
[Translator's note: the source text breaks off here with the incomplete phrase «يطلق على:» and nothing follows it in the entry.]

safi-cedvel:12-13.t:
* I'rab:
(الكاف) a preposition of comparison. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governing word is نسلك; the reference is to the mockery and the denial. (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) indicates address. (نسلكه) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is "We", for magnification, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi [Note: the commentators differed over the referent of the pronoun. Al-Zamakhsharī said that it refers to الذكر, and the reference of the demonstrative, for him, is to the "threading" (salk). Ibn ʿAṭiyya said that it refers to the mockery and the polytheism. It is related from Mujāhid: "We thread the denial". Abū Ḥayyān prefers Ibn ʿAṭiyya's view ...]. (في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نسلكه). (المجرمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «نسلكه ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(لا) negative. (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative; and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يؤمنون); the bāʾ is causal, and the pronoun refers to the demonstrative [Note: it is permissible for (به) to be attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of the negated يؤمنون, that is: "mocking it".]. (الواو) resumptive. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (خلت) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (سنّة) fāʿil, nominative. (الأولين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or an explanation of (نسلكه) [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in نسلكه, that is: "not believed in" (passive participle form), the third-person pronoun being الذكر.].
The clause «خلت سنّة الأولين» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- Analogical simile (tashbīh tamthīlī): in His saying, the Exalted, كَذلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ etc....
The speech contains an analogical simile for the obstinacy that has taken hold of them, the obstinacy firmly rooted in their breasts. The detail of it is that Allah the Exalted threaded the Qur'an into their hearts and made it enter their innermost cores, just as He threaded it into the hearts of the believers who affirm its truth; so these denied it and those affirmed it, each upon knowledge and clear proof, so that whoever perishes may perish upon clear proof and whoever lives may live upon clear proof, and so that the disbelievers may have no argument against Allah that they did not understand the aspects of the inimitability as those who believed understood them. So Allah the Exalted informed them from now, while they are still in a respite and possibility, that they disbelieved only with knowledge, being obstinate and transgressing, so that it may be more refuting of any argument they fabricate and more negating of every claim they make.

safi-cedvel:14-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (فتحنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (فتحنا). (بابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (بابا). (الفاء) conjunction. (ظلّوا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and (الواو) is the ism of ظلّ. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يعرجون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative; and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «فتحنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ظلّوا.. يعرجون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يعرجون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of ظلّوا.
(اللام) occurring in the answer to لو. (قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (إنّما) kāffa and makfūfa. (سكّرت) a passive past verb; and (التاء) is for the feminine. (أبصارنا) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative; and (نا) is a muḍāf ilayhi. (بل) for transitional iḍrāb (turning away). (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (قوم) khabar, nominative. (مسحورون) naʿt of قوم, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the non-jussive condition (لو).
The clause «سكّرت أبصارنا ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «نحن قوم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مسحورون): plural of مسحور, a passive participle of the triliteral سحر; its wazn is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, إِنَّما سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصارُنا, they meant by it that our sight has been corrupted and a defect has befallen its perception, just as that befalls the mind of the drunkard so that his perception is impaired.
2- In the two words of restriction and iḍrāb there is an indication that they build their saying upon this, and that what they see has no reality, but is a matter made to appear to them through sorcery. The clarification of this is that they said "إنما", which conveys restriction to what is mentioned last, so the restriction falls on the eyes and not on the "intoxication"; as if they said: our eyes were intoxicated, not our minds. And though we imagine these things with our eyes, we know with our minds that the situation is otherwise, that is, that it has no reality. Then they said "بل", as if they turned away from restricting it to the eyes and said: rather it went beyond that to our minds through a sorcery he has wrought on us.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negative. (ننزّل) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is "We", for magnification. (الملائكة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إلّا) for restriction. (بالحق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from الملائكة [Note: or attached to (ننزّل), the bāʾ being for aid (istiʿāna). Al-Zamakhsharī made it an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, that is: "except a sending-down accompanied by the truth".]. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) like the first. (كانوا) a defective past verb, and (الواو) is the ism of كان. (إذا) a particle of response with no governing effect. (منظرين) khabar of كانوا, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «ما ننزّل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما كانوا.. منظرين» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Rhetoric:
- Scrambled laff and nashr (enumeration followed by distribution): in His saying, the Exalted, ما نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَما كانُوا إِذاً مُنْظَرِينَ.
The speech is directed by Him, Glorified, to His Prophet ﷺ, as an answer to their reported saying and a rejection of their false proposal, which arose from sheer partisanship and obstinacy, namely their saying لَوْ ما تَأْتِينا بِالْمَلائِكَةِ. As for His reply to their first saying, namely إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ, it is His saying, the Exalted, which comes next: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ.

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ [Note: or a pronoun borrowed for the position of the accusative, as tawkīd of the ism of إنّ.]. (نزّلنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (الذكر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (إنّا) like the first. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (حافظون). (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (حافظون) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «إنّا نحن نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «نحن نزّلنا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «نزّلنا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ نحن.
The clause «إنّا له لحافظون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:16-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (جعلنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (في السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جعلنا) in the sense of "We created" [Note: if it is transitive to two objects, the prepositional phrase is attached to an omitted element which is the second object.]. (بروجا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (زيّناها) like جعلنا, and (ها) is mafʿūl bihi. (للناظرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun [Note: or attached to (زيّناها), the lām being the lām of semantic ownership.].
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «زيّناها ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جعلنا.
(الواو) conjunction. (حفظناها من كلّ) like زيّناها للناظرين, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (حفظناها). (شيطان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (رجيم) naʿt of شيطان, genitive.
The clause «حفظناها ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جعلناها.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as a discontinuous or continuous exception [Note: that is: "but whoever eavesdrops, the meteor snatches him", or "whoever eavesdrops hears something of their news". Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī allowed (من) to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause أتبعه, with the fāʾ redundant because of the mubtadaʾ's resemblance to a condition; the exception is then discontinuous.]. (استرق) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he", which is the returning pronoun. (السمع) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء) conjunction. (أتبعه) like استرق, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi. (شهاب) fāʿil, nominative. (مبين) naʿt of شهاب, nominative.
The clause «استرق ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «أتبعه شهاب ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
(الواو) conjunction. (الأرض) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb in the manner of ishtighāl (preoccupation), explained by what comes after it. (مددناها) like زيّناها. (الواو) conjunction. (ألقينا) like جعلنا. (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (ألقينا). (رواسي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (وأنبتنا فيها) like وألقينا فيها. (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, an adjective of an implied element, that is: "kinds of every thing". (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (موزون) naʿt of شيء, genitive.
The clause «(مددنا) الأرض ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جعلنا ...
The clause «مددناها (the mentioned one)» has no grammatical position; explicative.
The clause «ألقينا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause (مددنا) الأرض.
The clause «أنبتنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause (مددنا) الأرض.
(الواو) conjunction. (جعلنا) like the first. (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (جعلنا) in the sense of "We created" [Note: if it is transitive to two objects, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element which is the second object]. (فيها) like the preceding, attached to (جعلنا). (معايش) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, conjoined to معايش [Note: and it is, in the opinion of al-Zajjāj, mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "We provided livelihood for those whom you are not ..."; and it is said that it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, as the meaning indicates it, that is: "those whom you are not providers for, We made livelihoods for them in it". The Kufans, and with them al-Akhfash, said it is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the pronoun in (لكم).]. (لستم) a defective, inert past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and (تم) is a pronoun, the ism of ليس. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) in the position of a genitive, attached to رازقين. (الباء) a redundant preposition. (رازقين) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ليس, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «جعلنا لكم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause (مددنا) الأرض.
The clause «لستم.. برازقين» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(شهاب): an inert noun for a burning body that falls from the sky; its wazn is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ; its plural is شهب, with two ḍammas.
(موزون): a passive participle of the triliteral وزن; its wazn is مفعول.
(معايش): plural of معيشة, a noun for that by which a person lives during his lifetime of food, drink, and clothing. The wazn of معيشة is مفعلة, with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and it contains an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by sukūn, in that the yāʾ was given sukūn and its vowel was moved to the ʿayn before it. The yāʾ was not turned into a hamza in (معايش) because it is original.

* Rhetoric:
- Figurative usage (majāz): in His saying, the Exalted, مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ, that is: measured by a specific measure that wisdom requires. It is a majāz used for a necessary concomitant of its meaning, or a kināya; or it means "of everything pleasing and well proportioned", from their saying: "a well-measured (balanced) speech".

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إن) negative. (من) a redundant preposition. (شيء) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ. (إلّا) for restriction. (عندنا) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (نا) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (خزائنه) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative.
And (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative. (ننزّله) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We", for magnification. (إلّا) like the first. (بقدر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ننزّله) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from the object, that is: "accompanied by a known measure".]. (معلوم) naʿt of قدر, genitive.
The clause «إن من شيء إلّا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «عندنا خزائنه ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (شيء).
The clause «ننزّله ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(قدر): a noun for what Allah decrees, and for the attachment of the will to its times; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
- Metaphor: in His saying, the Exalted, وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنا خَزائِنُهُ. His unseen, countless decreed things, which fall under His all-encompassing power, are likened, in being concealed from the knowledge of all the worlds and guarded from their hands reaching them, to the precious goods stored in royal treasuries. So the mention of "treasuries" is in the manner of imaginative metaphor (istiʿāra takhyīliyya). It is also allowed that His power over everything, and His bringing into being whatever He wills, is likened to treasuries in which things are deposited, prepared so that He may bring out of them what He wills; so this is mentioned by way of analogical metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya).

* Benefits:
وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ.
This «إن» is negative, and that is why «من» comes after it, which is a redundant preposition that occurs to give emphasis. «إن» has several kinds. We have treated them fully elsewhere earlier, so we content ourselves with merely recalling them here.

safi-cedvel:22-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (أرسلنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (الرياح) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (لواقح) ḥāl, accusative. (الفاء) conjunction. (أنزلنا ... ماء) like أرسلنا الرياح. (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلنا). (الفاء) conjunction. (أسقينا) like أرسلنا, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and (الميم) is for the masculine plural, and (الواو) is redundant, the filling out of the vowel of the mīm, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, a second mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl. (ما) negative, working like ليس. (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, its ism. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to خازنين. (الباء) a redundant preposition. (خازنين) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.
The clause «أسقيناكموه ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أنزلنا.
The clause «ما أنتم ... بخازنين» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the second-person pronoun in (أسقيناكم) [Note: that is: "while you are unable to bring it into being".].
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّا) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إن. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause نحيي. (نحيي) an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; the fāʿil is "We", for magnification. (الواو) conjunction. (نميت) an imperfect verb, nominative. (نحن) like the first. (الوارثون) the second khabar of نحن, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «إنّا لنحن ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أسقيناكموه.
The clause «نحن نحيي ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «نحيي ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of نحن.
The clause «نميت ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause نحيي.
The clause «نحن الوارثون» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause نحن نحيي.
(الواو) conjunction. (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (علمنا) like أرسلنا. (المستقدمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ. (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun, in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from المستقدمين. (ولقد علمنا المستأخرين) like the preceding one.
The clause «قد علمنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّا لنحن..
The clause «قد علمنا (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the implied oath, and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the first oath clause.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّ) like the first. (ربك) the ism of إنّ, accusative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (يحشرهم) like نميت, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "He". (إنّه) like إنّا. (حكيم) khabar of إنّ, nominative. (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّ ربّك هو ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the implied oath clause.
The clause «هو يحشرهم ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يحشرهم ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of هو.
The clause «إنّه حكيم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(لواقح): plural of لاقحة, feminine of لاقح, an active participle of the triliteral لقح [Note: it is said that it is the plural of ملقح (with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the qāf) from the quadriliteral ألقح, whose plural is ملاقح, and then the mīm was dropped for lightness. In al-Mukhtār: "the stallion impregnated (alqaḥa) the she-camel, and the wind the clouds; and 'impregnating winds' is ريح لواقح, and do not say ملاقح, for it is among the rarities", end. And in al-Muḥīṭ: "the winds impregnated (alqaḥat) the trees, so they are لواقح and ملاقح".]; its wazn is فاعل.
(خازنين): plural of خازن, an active participle of the triliteral خزن; its wazn is فاعل.
(المستقدمين): plural of المستقدم, an active participle of the sextiliteral استقدم; its wazn is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(المستأخرين): plural of المستأخر, an active participle of the sextiliteral استأخر; its wazn is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
- Eloquent simile (tashbīh baligh): in His saying, the Exalted, وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّياحَ لَواقِحَ. اللواقح is the plural of لاقح, meaning "pregnant", and the winds are described thus by way of the eloquent simile: the wind laden with rain-bearing cloud is likened to a pregnant she-camel, because it carries that cloud or the water in it. What is meant is "impregnators" of the cloud or the trees, so that "impregnation" (laqḥ) is borrowed for the pouring of rain into the cloud or the trees.

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لقد خلقنا الإنسان) like لقد علمنا المستقدمين [Note: in verse (24) of this sūra.]. (من صلصال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلقنا). (من حمأ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of صلصال [Note: or it is a badal from صلصال with the repetition of the preposition.]. (مسنون) naʿt of حمأ, genitive.
The clause «خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction. (الجانّ خلقناه) like الأرض [Note: in verse (19) of this sūra] مددناها. (من) a preposition. (قبل) a noun indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of a genitive, attached to (خلقناه). (من نار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلقناه). (السموم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «(خلقنا) الجانّ ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause خلقنا الإنسان.
The clause «خلقناه ...» has no grammatical position; explicative.

* Morphology:
(صلصال): a noun for dry clay; its wazn is فعلال.
(حمأ): a noun for black mud; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas.
(مسنون): a passive participle of the triliteral سنّ; its wazn is مفعول.
(الجانّ): a collective noun for the jinn, and it is on the wazn فاعل; its plural is جنّان, with kasra on the jīm and a doubled fatḥa on the nūn.
(السموم): a noun for the hot wind, or the fire that has no smoke; its wazn is فعول, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember". (قال) a past verb. (ربّك) fāʿil, nominative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (للملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال). (إنّي) like إنّا [Note: in verse (23) of this sūra.]. (خالق) khabar of إنّ, nominative. (بشرا) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle خالق, accusative. (من صلصال من حمأ مسنون) their i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (26) of this sūra], and the first genitive phrase is attached to خالق.
The clause «قال ربك ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّي خالق ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
(الفاء) conjunction. (إذا) an adverb of future time, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to the content of the answer. (سوّيت) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) conjunction. (نفخت) like سوّيت. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نفخت). (من روحي) a preposition attached to نفخت, its genitive marking being the implied kasra on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis. (قعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn ...
and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (له) [Translator's note: the source reads «(له) فيه متعلّق ب (قعوا)», where فيه appears to be a slip for the intended wording; translated as written: "(له) in it attached to (قعوا)"] [Note: or attached to ساجدين..]. (ساجدين) ḥāl, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «سوّيته ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نفخت ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause سوّيته.
The clause «قعوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to a non-jussive condition.

safi-cedvel:30-31.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive. (سجد) a past verb. (الملائكة) fāʿil, nominative. (كلّهم) tawkīd maʿnawī (semantic emphasis) of الملائكة, nominative like it, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in genitive construct. (أجمعون) a second semantic tawkīd, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «سجد الملائكة ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (إبليس) a noun, accusative as a discontinuous or continuous exception, according to the well-known disagreement over the reality of Iblīs, whether he is of the angels or not. (أبى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa on the alif; the fāʿil is "he". (أن) a particle of accusative and of maṣdar. (يكون) a defective imperfect verb, accusative, its ism a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he). (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of يكون. (الساجدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون ...) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi, the governing word being أبى «1».
The clause «أبى ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "He". (يا) a vocative particle. (إبليس) the one addressed, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, a singular proper name. (ما) an interrogative noun, for rebuke, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the khabar of ما. (أن) a maṣdar particle that governs the accusative. (لا) negative. (تكون مع الساجدين) like يكون مع الساجدين «2», and its ism is "you". The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تكون ...) is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, namely في, attached to an omitted ḥāl, that is: "What is with you in your not being with the prostrators", that is: what is your excuse, while you are not prostrating with the others.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يا إبليس مالك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying. [Note: In the preceding verse (31).] And the clause «مالك ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the vocative.

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the preceding [Note: in the preceding verse (32).]. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (أكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, its ism a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا" (I). (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd). (أسجد) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial; the fāʿil is "I". (لبشر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أسجد).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أسجد ...) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of أكن.
(خلقته) like سوّيته [Note: in verse (29) of this sūra.
(3, 4) in verse (26) of this sūra.]. (من صلصال ... مسنون) their i'rab has already been given «3».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «لم أكن ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أسجد ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied maṣdar particle (أن).
The clause «خلقته ...» is in the position of a genitive, naʿt of بشر.

safi-cedvel:34-35.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the preceding «4». (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (اخرج) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (اخرج). (الفاء) causal. (إنّك) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (رجيم) khabar of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «اخرج ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you are not content with prostration, then go out".. and the implied conditional clause is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «إنّك رجيم» has no grammatical position; causal.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّ) like the first. (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the fronted khabar of إنّ. (اللعنة) the postponed ism of إنّ, accusative. (إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اللعنة [Note: or attached to the "settledness" (istiqrār) which is the khabar.]. (الدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «إنّ عليك اللعنة ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّك رجيم.

* Rhetoric:
- Kināya (indirect expression): in His saying, the Exalted, فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ, that is: driven away from all good and honour, for one who is driven away is stoned with stones; so the speech is of the type of kināya.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he", Iblīs. (ربّ) the one addressed, a muḍāf from which the vocative particle is omitted, accusative, its accusative marking being the implied fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ that was dropped for lightness.. and the omitted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (انظرني) an imperative verb of supplication, and (النون) is protective and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, while the fāʿil is "you". (إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنظر). (يبعثون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the retention of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «the vocative and its answer» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «انظرني ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if You drove me away and cursed me, then grant me respite".. and the implied conditional clause has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the vocative.
The clause «يبعثون» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.

safi-cedvel:37-38.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the preceding [Note: in verse (36).]. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (إنّك) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (34) of this sūra.]. (من المنظرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّك من المنظرين» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you want the respite, then you are among those granted respite", and the implied conditional clause is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
(إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المنظرين. (الوقت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (المعلوم) naʿt of الوقت, genitive.

safi-cedvel:39-40.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ) their i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse 36.]. (الباء) a preposition [Note: it is causal according to some commentators, because swearing by the leading astray is not customary; and it is the bāʾ of oath according to others, because leading astray can be sworn by as being an act of Allah ...]. (ما) a maṣdar particle. (أغويتني) a past verb together with its fāʿil.. and (النون) is protective and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (اللام) the lām of oath. (أزيّننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative, and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is "I". (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أزيّننّ). (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the implied object of أزيّننّ, that is: "I will surely make disobedience appear attractive to them, existing on the earth" [Note: or a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لهم).].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أغويتني) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear", that is: "I swear by Your leading me astray that I will surely make attractive" [Note: see verse (16) of Sūrat al-Aʿrāf, which is the counterpart of this one in i'rab, and in it there is further clarification regarding the attachment of the bāʾ and the permissibility of making it causal.].
(الواو) conjunction. (لأغوينّهم) like لأزيّننّ, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (أجمعين) tawkīd of the third-person pronoun هم, accusative (or a ḥāl from it), its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «the vocative and its answer» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أغويتني» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (ما).
The clause «أزيننّ لهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the oath.. and the oath clause with its answer is the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أغوينّهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the oath-answer clause.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (عبادك) the excepted, accusative.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from عبادك. (المخلصين) naʿt of عبادك, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.

* Benefits:
- His saying: رَبِّ بِما أَغْوَيْتَنِي.
Some grammarians considered the «باء» to be the bāʾ of oath, as if he were saying: "I swear by Your leading me astray". We do not hold this opinion; the bāʾ here is causal, for he is saying: "I will make things attractive to them on the earth and lead them all astray because of Your leading me astray". The meaning on this reading is closer to the Arabic natural disposition and dispenses with an implied element for which there is no need.

safi-cedvel:41-44.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "He". (ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (صراط) khabar, nominative. (على) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an adjective of صراط. (مستقيم) a second naʿt, nominative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «هذا صراط ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (عبادي) the ism of إنّ, accusative, its accusative marking being the implied fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (ليس) a defective, inert past verb. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the khabar of ليس. (عليهم) like عليّ, attached to a ḥāl from سلطان (an adjective that preceded the described noun). (سلطان) the postponed ism of ليس. (إلّا) a particle of exception. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as a discontinuous exception [Note: it is said that it is an exception because the servants are all those held to account, and from them are excepted those who followed Satan.. As for its being discontinuous, it is because Satan has no authority over all the servants; and their following him is by his making things attractive.]. (اتّبعك) a past verb, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "he", which is the returning pronoun. (من الغاوين) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the pronoun of the fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ عبادي ليس ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the preceding saying.
The clause «ليس لك.. سلطان» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّ جهنّم) like إنّ عبادي; جهنّم is withheld from tanwīn because of being a proper name and feminine. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (موعدهم) khabar of إنّ, nominative..
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أجمعين) tawkīd for the pronoun in موعدهم, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ جهنّم لموعدهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ عبادي..
(لها) like لك, attached to a fronted khabar. (سبعة) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أبواب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. (باب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (جزء) [Note: جزء in the sense of a group or party.
(2, 3) it is permissible for it to be resumptive, in which case it has no position.], which is a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (مقسوم) naʿt of جزء, nominative.
The clause «لها سبعة أبواب» is in the position of a nominative, a second khabar of (إنّ) «2».
The clause «لكلّ باب.. جزء ...» is in the position of a nominative, naʿt of سبعة أبواب, and the linking element is implied, that is: "for every door of them" «3».

* Morphology:
(جزء): a noun for a part of a thing, from جزأ يجزأ (of the bāb of fatḥa); its wazn is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn; its plural is أجزاء, on the wazn أفعال. Like الجزء with ḍamma are الجزء with fatḥa and also الجزاء with fatḥa.
(مقسوم): a passive participle of the triliteral قسم; its wazn is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in His saying, the Exalted, قالَ هذا صِراطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ, and perhaps it is among the most eloquent concisions, because it is the counterpart of concision by omission; it is concision by implication (ījāz bi-l-taqdīr). It is of two kinds: one in which the expression equals its meaning, and the other in which the meaning exceeds the expression, called qaṣr (compression), since its expression indicates numerous possibilities and many contents that cannot be expressed in the like of its words and their number; indeed this is impossible. His saying «هذا» is a pointer indicating nearness, as if he is pointing to what is before their eyes, within their hearing, and within reach of their hands; and صراط indicates the trodden road which leads whoever walks it to whichever of the paths he chooses for himself; but a road may be crooked, twisting, with many bends, so the traveller gets lost in its wildernesses and the means of guidance become confused for him in walking it; so He brought the word «مستقيم», and the straight is the shortest distance between two points, and the least deviation takes it out of the norms and limits of straightness. The word «علي» means obligation and necessity; you say "عليّ the covenant of Allah that I will do so", so you sense that you have bound yourself to what is a right that must be performed. Then the pointer contained everything that the exception afterwards contains, namely His saying إِلَّا عِبادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ, as if He had taken upon Himself and made binding on His own Self a right from which there is no release, namely to deliver the sincere ones from his leading astray.
2- Mockery (tahakkum):
His saying, Glorified and Exalted, إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ. It is not hidden what there is in making Hell their appointed place of mockery and metaphor, as if they were on an appointment; and in it also is a pointer that what has been prepared for them in it is beyond description in its horror.

safi-cedvel:45-48.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ المتّقين) like إنّ عبادي [Note: in verse (42) of this sūra.]; the accusative marking in المتّقين is the yāʾ. (في جنّات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (عيون) conjoined to جنّات by the wāw, genitive.
The clause «إنّ المتّقين في جنّات» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(ادخلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بسلام) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the fāʿil. (آمنين) a second ḥāl [Note: this is if السلام means greeting; but if السلام means safety and the opposite of fear, then it is permissible for (آمنين) to be a badal from the first ḥāl.] from the pronoun of the fāʿil, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «ادخلوها ...» is in the position of an accusative, being the content of an implied saying, that is: "the angels say to them: enter it..".
(الواو) conjunction. (نزعنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (في صدورهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما ...
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (من غلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the returning pronoun in the implied ṣila. (إخوانا) a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in صدورهم [Note: because the muḍāf is part of the muḍāf ilayhi; and it is permissible for it to be a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ادخلوها, as al-ʿUkbarī said; and it is permissible for a ḥāl to come inert because it is qualified.]. (على سرر) a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt of (إخوانا). (متقابلين) a second naʿt, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «نزعنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(لا) negative. (يمسّهم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the verb يمسّ. (نصب) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, working like ليس. (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, the ism of ما. (منها) like فيها, attached to (مخرجين). (الباء) a redundant preposition. (مخرجين) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «لا يمسّهم.. نصب» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in متقابلين [Note: or it has no position; resumptive..].
The clause «ما هم منها بمخرجين» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.

* Morphology:
(سرر): plural of سرير, a noun for what one sits upon, made comfortable for delight (surūr); it is taken from it because it is a seat of delight; its wazn is فعيل.
(متقابلين): plural of متقابل, an active participle of the quinqueliteral تقابل; its wazn is متفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(مخرجين): plural of مخرج, a passive participle of the quadriliteral أخرج; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:49-52.t:
* I'rab:
(نبّئ) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (عبادي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the implied fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of أنّ. (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ [Note: or a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative, as tawkīd of the ism of أنّ, borrowed for the position of the accusative; and its being a separator (faṣl) is weak because what comes after it would not be confused with an adjective.]. (الغفور) khabar, nominative. (الرحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي أنا الغفور..) is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the second and third objects of the verb نبّأ.
The clause «نبّئ ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أنا الغفور ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (أنّ عذابي هو العذاب الأليم) like أنّي أنا الغفور الرحيم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن عذابي ... ) is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «هو العذاب ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (نبّئهم) like the first.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن ضيف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبّئ). (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the fatḥa.
The clause «نبّئهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause نبّئ عبادي.
(إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to (ضيف) [Note: by its being a maṣdar.. or attached to an omitted muḍāf, that is: "about the report of the guests of Ibrāhīm when they entered ..."].
(دخلوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (دخلوا). (الفاء) conjunction. (قالوا) like دخلوا. (سلاما) mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, that is: "We greet with a greeting". (قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (إنّا) like إنّي. (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (وجلون), which is the khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «دخلوا ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause دخلوا.
The clause «(نسلّم) سلاما» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّا منكم ووجلون» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.

* Morphology:
(ضيف): a noun for the visitor. The original of ضيف is a maṣdar, which is why the singular and plural are alike in it in most of their speech; it may also be pluralised as أضياف, ضيوف and ضيفان. The wazn of ضيف is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(وجلون): plural of وجل, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from وجل يوجل (of the bāb of فرح); its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra.

* Benefits:
- That the verse نَبِّئْ عِبادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ occurs on the metre of the baḥr al-mujtathth is no proof that the noble Qur'an is poetry, because that occurred incidentally, not intended in itself, and there is nothing to prevent the metre of poetry from fitting it.
This leads us to touch upon the metres of poetry and their names. Al-Akhfash said: I asked al-Khalīl: why was the ṭawīl called ṭawīl? He said: because it is long (ṭāla) with the completeness of its parts. I said: and the basīṭ? He said: because it extends (inbasaṭa) beyond the range of the ṭawīl. I said: and the wāfir? He said: for the abundance (wufūr) of its parts, peg upon peg. I said: and the kāmil? He said: because it has thirty vowelled letters (ḥaraka) that are not combined in any other poetry. I said: and the hazaj? He said: because it is agitated, like the hazaj of a voice. I said: and the rajaz? He said: because of its agitation, like the agitation of a she-camel's legs when she stands. I said: and the raml? He said: because it is "tripped" (yarmulu) by joining some to others. I said: and the sarīʿ? He said: because it hastens (yusriʿu) on the tongue. I said: and the munsariḥ? He said: for its flowing (insirāḥ) and ease. I said: and the khafīf? He said: because it is the lightest of the seven-part metres. I said: and the muqtaḍab? He said: because it was cut off (uqtuḍiba) from the sarīʿ. I said: and the muḍāriʿ? He said: because it resembles (ḍāraʿa) the muqtaḍab. I said: and the mujtathth? He said: because it was uprooted (ujtutha), that is cut off, from the long circle. I said: and the mutaqārib? He said: for the closeness (taqārub) of its parts, because they are all five-letter feet resembling one another.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (توجل) an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is "you". (إنّا) like إنّي [Note: in verse (49) of this sūra.]. (نبشّرك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We". (بغلام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبشّر). (عليم) naʿt of غلام, genitive.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا توجل ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «إنّا نبشّرك ...» has no grammatical position; a causal resumption.
The clause «نبشّرك ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
- Majāz mursal (unrestricted figurative usage): in His saying, the Exalted, قالُوا لا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلامٍ عَلِيمٍ.
A human being is not born a boy knowledgeable of affairs; he is born an infant who knows nothing, and these two words were applied to him in view of what he will become.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (الهمزة) for interrogation of astonishment. (بشّرتم) a past verb together with its fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant, the filling out of the vowel of the mīm, and (النون) is protective and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (على) a preposition. (أن) a maṣdar particle. (مسّني) a past verb, and (النون) is protective, and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (الكبر) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن مسّني..) is in the position of a genitive by (على), attached to a ḥāl from the first-person pronoun, that is: "Have you given me good news while I am old?".
(الفاء) conjunction. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تبشّرون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the retention of the nūn..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «أبشّرتموني ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «مسّني الكبر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (أن).
The clause «تبشّرون» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the content of the saying.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (بشّرنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشرنا). (الفاء) conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (تكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, its ism a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you). (من القانطين) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of تكن, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «بشّرناك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «لا تكن ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to a causal resumption, that is: "be alert, and do not be among the despairing".

* Morphology:
(القانطين): plural of القانط, an active participle of the triliteral قنط; its wazn is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (الواو) conjunction. (من) an interrogative noun containing the sense of negation, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (يقنط) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he). (من رحمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقنط). (ربّه) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (إلّا) for exception. (الضالّون) badal from the fāʿil of يقنط, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «من يقنط ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the implied clause that is the content of the saying, that is: "he said: I do not despair, and who despairs ..."
The clause «يقنط ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

* Benefits:
- «من»: the grammarians agree that من is originally for asking about a rational person, as in «من فعل هذا؟» ("Who did this?"). It may be infused with the sense of rhetorical negation, as in: مَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ, and of that is the verse before us: «وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ؟!».
And من comes conditional, as in His saying, the Exalted: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً يُجْزَ بِهِ. And it may come as an indefinite qualified noun, and that is when it is followed by a singular, or preceded by the governing «رُبَّ», as in «رأيت من محبّا لك», that is, "a person who loves you". Of this is the saying of Ḥassān ibn Thābit:
فكفى بنا فضلا على من غيرنا ... حب النبي محمد إيانا
(It suffices us as a merit above others: the love of the Prophet Muḥammad for us.) That is: "above a people other than us".

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the preceding [Note: in verse (56).]. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (خطبكم) khabar, nominative.. and (كم) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (أيّها) the one addressed, a specific indefinite, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative..
and (ها) is a particle of alerting. (المرسلون) naʿt of أيّ (or a badal) following it in the nominative in form, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما خطبكم ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you came for a reason other than the glad tidings, then what is your business".. and the condition clause with its apodosis is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أيّها المرسلون» has no grammatical position; a parenthetical appended remark (iʿtirāḍ tadhyīlī).

* Morphology:
(خطبكم): a noun meaning "affair"; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:58-60.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb..
and (نا) is the ism of إنّ. (أرسلنا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil. (إلى قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا). (مجرمين) naʿt of قوم, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّا أرسلنا ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (آل) the excepted, accusative, continuous or discontinuous [Note: the apparent is that it is discontinuous, because the excepted-from is (قوم مجرمين).]. (لوط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّا) like the first. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (منجّوهم) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.. and (هم) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (أجمعين) semantic tawkīd for the third-person pronoun in (منجّوهم), genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّا لمنجّوهم ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
(إلّا امرأته) like إلّا آل.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the exception is from آل لوط. (قدّرنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (إنّها) like إنّا. (اللام) like the first. (من الغابرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قدّرنا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّها لمن الغابرين» is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi of the verb قدّرنا, which is infused with the meaning "We knew" and is suspended (muʿallaq) by (إنّ) with kasra on the hamza because the lām occurs in its khabar.

* Morphology:
(منجّوهم): plural of المنجّي or منجٍ, an active participle of the quadriliteral نجّى; its wazn is مفعٍّ [Translator's note: the source prints «مفع»; the doubled ʿayn of مفعّ appears to have been lost in printing], and it contains an iʿlāl by deletion because of the meeting of two sukūns by reason of the tanwīn; the wazn of منجّوهم is مفعّوهم with ḍamma on the wāw, because it is a defective noun (manqūṣ).

safi-cedvel:61-62.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive. (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to (قال). (جاء) a past verb. (آل) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (لوط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (المرسلون) fāʿil, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «جاء ... المرسلون» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
(قال) like جاء. (إنّكم) like إنّا [Note: in verse (58) of this sūra.]. (قوم) khabar of إنّ, nominative. (منكرون) naʿt of قوم, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّكم قوم ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.

* Morphology:
(منكرون): plural of منكر, a passive participle of the quadriliteral أنكر; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn [Note: and see verse (104) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān; there it is a noun and here it is an adjective.].

safi-cedvel:63-65.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (بل) for transitional iḍrāb. (جئناك) a past verb together with its fāʿil.. and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (جئناك). (كانوا) a defective past verb together with its ism. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يمترون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.. and the content of the saying is omitted, its implied form being "We are not deniers".
The clause «جئناك ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يمترون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
(الواو) conjunction. (أتيناك) like جئناك. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أتينا, that is: "accompanied by the truth", or from its object, that is: "accompanied by it". (الواو) conjunction. (إنّا) like the preceding [Note: in verse (58) of this sūra.]. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (صادقون) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
(الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (أسر) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "you". (بأهلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أسر) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil.].. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (بقطع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أسر). (من الليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of قطع. (الواو) conjunction. (اتّبع) like أسر. (أدبارهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (يلتفت) an imperfect verb, jussive. (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (أحد) (an adjective that preceded the described noun). (أحد) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (امضوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, attached to (امضوا). (تؤمرون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «أتيناك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جئناك.
The clause «إنّا لصادقون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أتيناك [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أتيناك.].
The clause «أسر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied condition, that is: "if you want deliverance from your people, then travel by night with your family"..
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أسر.
The clause «لا يلتفت منكم أحد» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اتّبع ...
The clause «امضوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يلتفت منكم أحد ...
The clause «تأمرون [Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source] in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.

* Morphology:
(امضوا): it contains an iʿlāl by deletion, for the sake of the meeting of two sukūns; its original is امضيوا, the yāʾ having been dropped after its vowel was moved to the ḍād.

* Rhetoric:
- Kināya: in His saying, the Exalted, وَلا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ, it is possible that the meaning is "let none of you turn away, nor lag behind for some purpose, lest there befall him what befalls the criminals". So "turning" (iltifāt) is figurative, because turning to a thing requires love of it and not leaving it, so that one lags behind at it; or the prohibition against turning is made a kināya for continuing the journey and abandoning slackness and stopping, for whoever looks about must make at least a short pause in doing so.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قضينا) like جئنا [Note: in verse (63) of this sūra.]. (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (قضينا), which is infused with the meaning "We revealed". (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.. and (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) indicates address. (الأمر) badal from ذا (or ʿaṭf bayān). (أنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative. (دابر) the ism of أنّ, accusative. (ها) a particle of alerting. (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (مقطوع) khabar, nominative. (مصبحين) ḥāl, accusative, from the latent pronoun in مقطوع [Note: the "rear" of these is in the sense of "the rears of these", so مقطوع is in the sense of مقطوعين, which is why the ḥāl came in the plural form.], its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ دابر.. مقطوع) is in the position of an accusative, a badal from الأمر. The clause «قضينا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مقطوع): a passive participle of the triliteral قطع; its wazn is مفعول.
(مصبحين): plural of مصبح, an active participle of the quadriliteral أصبح; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (جاء) a past verb. (أهل) fāʿil, nominative. (المدينة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (يستبشرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاء أهل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يستبشرون» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from أهل.

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he", that is Lūṭ. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, a naskh particle. (هؤلاء) an alerting particle and a demonstrative in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (ضيفي) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the implied ḍamma on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (تفضحون) an imperfect verb, jussive, its jussive marking being the dropping of the nūn.. and (النون) is protective, and before it (الواو) is the fāʿil and (الياء), dropped to match the end of the verse, is mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّ هؤلاء ضيفي ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «لا تفضحون ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you honour me, then do not disgrace me", and the implied conditional clause is a resumption within the scope of the saying.
(الواو) conjunction. (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (لا تخزون) like لا تفضحون.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تفضحون.
The clause «لا تخزون» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تفضحون or the clause اتّقوا.

* Morphology:
(تخزون): it contains an iʿlāl by sukūn and an iʿlāl by deletion. Its original is تخزيون (with ḍamma on the yāʾ); the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so it was given sukūn and its vowel was moved to the zāy (iʿlāl by sukūn); then two sukūns met, the yāʾ and the wāw, so the yāʾ was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and it became تخزون, its wazn being تفعون.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (الهمزة) for interrogation. (الواو) conjunction. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (ننهك) an imperfect verb, jussive, its jussive marking being the dropping of the weak letter.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We". (عن العالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ننهك) with an omitted muḍāf, that is: "from the hospitality of the peoples of the worlds", its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لم ننهك ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the implied clause that is the content of the saying, that is: "Did We not warn you and forbid you from the worlds" [Note: or it is the clause that is the content of the saying, with the wāw redundant.].

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab:
(قال هؤلاء بناتي) like قال إنّ هؤلاء ضيفي [Note: in verse (68) of this sūra.]; and here it is a mubtadaʾ and khabar [Note: and in the speech there is an omission, that is: "so marry them.. and it is permissible for (بناتي) to be a badal from the demonstrative with an omitted khabar, its implied form being "purer for you"..]. (إن) a particle of jussive condition. (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable, in the position of a jussive, the protasis, and (تم) is in the position of a nominative, the ism of كنتم. (فاعلين) khabar of كنتم, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «هؤلاء بناتي ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «كنتم فاعلين ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.. and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then marry them" [Note: or "if you are going to do what I command you of turning back from error, then do it".].

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) the lām of ibtidāʾ (commencement). (عمرك) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the khabar is obligatorily omitted, its implied form being "my oath". (إنّهم) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative.. and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (اللام) the shifted lām (or the lām of oath). (في سكرتهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (يعمهون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «لعمرك (قسمي) ...» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
The clause «إنّهم لفي سكرتهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the oath.
The clause «يعمهون ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in سكرتهم [Note: and the governing word in it is the word سكرة, because it is a maṣdar.].

* Morphology:
(لعمر): with fatḥa on the ʿayn and sukūn on the mīm, a dialectal form of عُمُر with two ḍammas; the two have one meaning, which is the span of a person's life in this world; but the Arabs kept to the fatḥa on the ʿayn in oaths because it is lighter in pronunciation.
(سكرة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral سكر; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:73-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction. (أخذت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الصيحة) fāʿil, nominative. (مشرقين) ḥāl, accusative, from the pronoun of the object in (أخذتهم), its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «أخذتهم الصيحة ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied element [Note: that is: "they refused to comply, so the Cry seized them".. and the clause أبوا is conjoined to the clause قال هؤلاء - verse (71).].
(الفاء) conjunction. (جعلنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (عاليها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (ها) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (سافلها) a second mafʿūl bihi.. and (ها) is like the first. (الواو) conjunction. (أمطرنا) like جعلنا. (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أمطرنا). (حجارة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من سجّيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of حجارة.
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.

* Morphology:
(مشرقين): an active participle whose singular is مشرق from the quadriliteral أشرق, that is "entered upon sunrise"; its wazn is مفعل.

safi-cedvel:75-77.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative. (في) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to a fronted khabar.. and (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) indicates address. (اللام) the second, for emphasis. (آيات) the postponed ism of إنّ, accusative, its accusative marking being the kasra. (للمتوسّمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of آيات, its genitive marking being the yāʾ [Note: or attached to آيات, which is in the sense of "signs".].
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّها) like (إنّهم) [Note: in verse (72) of this sūra.]. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (بسبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (مقيم) naʿt of سبيل, genitive.
The clause has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ في ذلك.
